title.en: Volume 112 Treatises 87: Selection and Examinations 7, Juan Na
title.raw: 卷112 志八十七 选举七 捐纳

sentences.zh: 志八十七

translations.literal: Treatise Eighty-Seven
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 87

sentences.zh: 選舉七

translations.literal: Selection and Examinations Seven
translations.idiomatic: Selection and Examinations 7

sentences.zh: 捐納

translations.literal: Contribution and Purchase of Office
translations.idiomatic: Purchase of Offices

sentences.zh: 清制，入官重正途。

translations.literal: Under Qing institutions, entry into office valued the regular route.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Qing system, entry into official service prized the regular examination route.

sentences.zh: 自捐例開，官吏乃以資進。

translations.literal: Once contribution regulations were opened, officials and clerks advanced by wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Once purchase-of-office regulations were instituted, officials advanced by paying money.

sentences.zh: 其始固以蒐羅異途人才，補科目所不及，中葉而後，名器不尊，登進乃濫，仕途因之殽雜矣。

translations.literal: At first it was indeed to gather talent from irregular routes and supply what the examination subjects could not; after the mid-dynasty, prestigious titles were no longer honored, advancement became excessive, and the official path thereby grew confused.
translations.idiomatic: At first the system was meant to recruit talent from irregular channels and fill gaps the examinations could not; by the mid-dynasty prestigious ranks had lost their dignity, promotions had become indiscriminate, and the official career path grew increasingly muddled.

sentences.zh: 捐例不外拯荒、河工、軍需三者，曰暫行事例，期滿或事竣即停，而現行事例則否。

translations.literal: Contribution regulations were none other than famine relief, river works, and military supplies—these were called temporary regulations, halted when the term expired or the task ended; standing regulations were otherwise.
translations.idiomatic: Contribution regulations fell into three kinds—famine relief, river works, and military supplies—called temporary regulations, which ceased when the term expired or the project ended; standing regulations did not.

sentences.zh: 捐途文職小京官至郎中，未入流至道員；

translations.literal: On the contribution route for civil offices, from junior capital officials up to directors, and from below the regular grades up to circuit intendants;
translations.idiomatic: On the civil contribution route, ranks ran from junior capital officials up to directors, and from posts below the regular grades up to circuit intendants;

sentences.zh: 武職千、把總至參將。

translations.literal: for military offices, from platoon and company commanders up to brigade commanders.
translations.idiomatic: for military offices, from platoon and company commanders up to brigade commanders.

sentences.zh: 而職官並得捐升，改捐，降捐，捐選補各項班次、分髮指省、翎銜、封典、加級、紀錄。

translations.literal: Moreover, incumbent officials could also contribute for promotion, change of contribution category, demoted contribution, selection and supplementary appointment in various quotas, assignment to a designated province, plumes and insignia, enfeoffment titles, grade increases, and merit records.
translations.idiomatic: Incumbent officials could also purchase promotion, change or downgrade their contribution category, fill various selection quotas, obtain assignment to a designated province, plumes and insignia, enfeoffment titles, grade increases, and merit records.

sentences.zh: 此外降革留任、離任，原銜、原資、原翎得捐復，坐補原缺。

translations.literal: Besides this, those demoted or dismissed but retained, or who had left office, could restore original rank, seniority, or plumes by contribution and fill their former posts.
translations.idiomatic: Officials demoted or dismissed but retained in post, or who had left office, could also restore their former rank, seniority, or insignia by contribution and resume their original appointments.

sentences.zh: 試俸、歷俸、實授、保舉、試用、離任引見、投供、驗看、迴避得捐免。

translations.literal: Probationary salary, seniority salary, substantive appointment, recommendation, probation, audience on leaving office, reporting for duty, inspection, and avoidance could be waived by contribution.
translations.idiomatic: Probationary salary, seniority increments, substantive appointment, recommendation, probation, farewell audiences, reporting for duty, inspection, and avoidance requirements could all be waived by contribution.

sentences.zh: 平民得捐貢監、封典、職銜。

translations.literal: Commoners could contribute for tribute-student or academy-student status, enfeoffment titles, and nominal ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners could purchase tribute-student or Imperial Academy status, enfeoffment titles, and nominal ranks.

sentences.zh: 大抵貢監、銜封、加級、紀錄無關銓政者，屬現行事例，餘屬暫行事例。

translations.literal: Generally, tribute and academy students, insignia and enfeoffment, grade increases, and records unrelated to appointment administration belonged to standing regulations; the rest belonged to temporary regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Generally, tribute and academy students, insignia, enfeoffment, grade increases, and merit records that did not affect appointment administration fell under standing regulations; everything else fell under temporary regulations.

sentences.zh: 歷代捐例，時有變更，惟捐納官不得分吏、禮部，道、府非由曾任實缺正印官，捐納僅授簡缺，則著為令。

translations.literal: Contribution regulations of successive reigns changed from time to time; only that contributed officials could not be assigned to the Ministry of Personnel or Ministry of Rites, that circuit and prefectural posts not held by former substantive appointees in chief posts received only minor vacancies by contribution—these were fixed as statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Contribution regulations changed from reign to reign, but certain rules held firm: purchased officials could not be posted to the Ministries of Personnel or Rites; circuit and prefectural posts went only to former substantive appointees in chief posts, while others received only minor vacancies through purchase.

sentences.zh: 銓補則新捐班次視舊班為優，此通例也。

translations.literal: In selection and supplementary appointment, new contribution quotas took precedence over old quotas—this was the general rule.
translations.idiomatic: In selection and supplementary appointment, new contribution quotas took precedence over older ones—this was the standing rule.

sentences.zh: 捐事戶部捐納房主之，收捐或由外省，或由部庫，或省、部均得報捐。

translations.literal: Contribution affairs were managed by the Contribution Office of the Ministry of Revenue; collections might be made through provincial offices, through the ministry treasury, or contributions could be reported to either province or ministry.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue's Contribution Office administered purchase-of-office affairs; funds might be collected in the provinces, at the ministry treasury, or reported to either level.

sentences.zh: 咸豐後，並由京銅局。

translations.literal: After the Xianfeng reign, this was also handled by the Beijing Copper Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: After the Xianfeng era, the Beijing Copper Bureau also handled collections.

sentences.zh: 凡報捐者曰官生，部予以據，曰執照。

translations.literal: All who reported contributions were called contributor candidates; the ministry issued a document called a license.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who reported a contribution was termed a contributor candidate; the ministry issued a certificate called a license.

sentences.zh: 貢監並給國子監照。

translations.literal: Tribute and academy students also received Imperial Academy credentials.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute and academy students also received Imperial Academy credentials.

sentences.zh: 俊秀納貢監或職銜，貢監納職銜，由原籍地方官查具身家清白冊，季報或歲報。

translations.literal: Genteel youths purchasing tribute or academy status or nominal rank, and tribute or academy students purchasing nominal rank, had their native-place officials compile registers of family background and good character, reported quarterly or annually.
translations.idiomatic: Genteel youths purchasing tribute or academy status or nominal rank, and students purchasing nominal rank, required their home-district officials to compile registers attesting to family background and good character, filed quarterly or annually.

sentences.zh: 納職官者，查明有無違礙，取具族鄰甘結，依限造報。

translations.literal: Those purchasing official posts had impediments investigated, obtained sworn statements from clan and neighbors, and reported within the deadline.
translations.idiomatic: Those purchasing official posts had disqualifying factors investigated and submitted sworn statements from clan and neighbors, with reports filed by deadline.

sentences.zh: 逾限或查報不實，罪之。

translations.literal: Exceeding the deadline or making false reports was punished.
translations.idiomatic: Missing deadlines or filing false reports was punishable.

sentences.zh: 其大略也。

translations.literal: This was the general outline.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the general outline.

sentences.zh: 文官捐始康熙十三年，以用兵三籓，軍需孔亟，暫開事例。

translations.literal: Civil-office contributions began in the thirteenth year of Kangxi, when war against the Three Feudatories made military supplies urgently needed and regulations were opened temporarily.
translations.idiomatic: Civil-office purchases began in Kangxi 13 (1674), when war against the Three Feudatories created desperate need for military funds and temporary regulations were opened.

sentences.zh: 十六年，左都御史宋德宜言：「開例三載，知縣捐至五百餘人。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Left Censor-in-Chief Song Deyi said: "Regulations have been open three years; district magistrates purchased by contribution have reached more than five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 16 (1677), Left Censor-in-Chief Song Deyi said: "Regulations have been open three years, and more than five hundred district magistrates have been purchased.

sentences.zh: 始因缺多易得，踴躍爭趨。

translations.literal: At first, because vacancies were many and easy to obtain, people eagerly rushed forward.
translations.idiomatic: At first vacancies were plentiful and easy to obtain, so contributors rushed to compete.

sentences.zh: 今見非數年不克選授，徘徊觀望。

translations.literal: Now they see that without several years they cannot be selected and appointed, and they hesitate and watch.
translations.idiomatic: Now they see that appointment takes years, and they hang back in hesitation.

sentences.zh: 宜限期停止，俾輸捐恐後。

translations.literal: It is fitting to set a deadline for stopping, so that those paying contributions will fear being too late.
translations.idiomatic: A deadline for closing should be set, so that latecomers fear missing their chance to contribute.

sentences.zh: 既有濟軍需，亦慎重名器。

translations.literal: This would both aid military supplies and honor prestigious titles.
translations.idiomatic: This would meet military needs while safeguarding the dignity of official ranks.

sentences.zh: 」帝納其言。

translations.literal: " The emperor accepted his words.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor accepted his advice.

sentences.zh: 滇南收復，捐例停。

translations.literal: When Yunnan was recovered, contribution regulations ceased.
translations.idiomatic: When Yunnan was recovered, purchase regulations were halted.

sentences.zh: 嗣以西安、大同飢，又永定河工，復開事例。

translations.literal: Later, because of famine in Xi'an and Datong and Yongding River works, regulations were opened again.
translations.idiomatic: Later famine in Xi'an and Datong and works on the Yongding River led to reopening the regulations.

sentences.zh: 五十一年，增置通州倉廒，科臣有請開捐者，廷議如所請。

translations.literal: In the fifty-first year, when granaries at Tongzhou were to be expanded, a censor requested opening contributions; the court deliberated and agreed.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 51 (1712), when Tongzhou granaries were to be expanded, a censor requested opening contributions, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 侍郎王掞抗疏言：「鄉里童騃，一旦捐資，儼然民上。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Wang Yan submitted a forceful memorial saying: "Village simpletons, once they contribute funds, suddenly stand above the people.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Wang Yan submitted a forceful memorial: "Country simpletons who pay once suddenly stand above the people they govern.

sentences.zh: 或分一縣之符，或擁一道之節，不惟濫傷名器，抑且為累地方。

translations.literal: Some hold a county's seal, others wield a circuit's authority—not only injuring prestigious titles excessively, but also becoming a burden on local regions.
translations.idiomatic: Some hold a county seal, others wield a circuit's authority—this not only debases prestigious ranks but burdens the regions they govern.

sentences.zh: 宜禁止，以塞僥倖之路，杜言利之門。

translations.literal: It is fitting to forbid this, to block the path of opportunism and shut the door to profit-seeking.
translations.idiomatic: It should be forbidden, to block opportunism and shut the door to profiteering.

sentences.zh: 」帝韙之，為飭九卿再議。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved this and ordered the Nine Ministers to deliberate again.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved and ordered the Nine Ministers to reconsider.

sentences.zh: 青海用兵，饋餉不繼，內大臣議停各途守選及遷補，專用捐資助餉者。

translations.literal: When Qinghai was at war and supplies did not keep up, inner ministers proposed halting selection and transfer along all routes and using only those who contributed funds to aid supplies.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qinghai campaign, when supplies ran short, inner ministers proposed suspending normal selection and transfers and relying solely on contributors to fund the army.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書張廷樞言；

translations.literal: Minister of Justice Zhang Tingshu said:
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Justice Zhang Tingshu said:

sentences.zh: 「惟捐納所分員缺可用捐員，正途及遷補者宜仍舊。

translations.literal: "Only the posts allotted to contribution appointees may use contributed officials; the regular route and transfer appointees should remain as before.
translations.idiomatic: "Only posts reserved for purchased officials should use contributors; regular-route and transfer appointees should remain unchanged.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was followed.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，開阿爾台運米事例。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng, the Altai grain-transport regulations were opened.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2 (1724), the Altai grain-transport purchase regulations were opened.

sentences.zh: 五年，直隸水災，議興營田，從大學士硃軾請，開營田事例。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Zhili suffered flood; colonization farming was discussed, and following Grand Secretary Zhu Shi's request, colonization regulations were opened.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 (1727), floods struck Zhili; following Grand Secretary Zhu Shi's request, colonization-farming purchase regulations were opened.

sentences.zh: 雲貴總督鄂爾泰以滇、黔墾荒，經費無著，請開捐如營田例。

translations.literal: Yunnan-Guizhou Governor Ortai, because Yunnan and Guizhou were opening wasteland with no funds allocated, requested opening contributions like the colonization regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan-Guizhou Governor Ortai, finding no funds for land reclamation in Yunnan and Guizhou, requested purchase regulations modeled on the colonization example.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「墾田事例，於地方有裨益。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Colonization regulations benefit local regions.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Colonization regulations benefit the regions.

sentences.zh: 向因各捐例人多。

translations.literal: Previously, because contributors under various regulations were numerous,
translations.idiomatic: Previously, because contributors under the various regulations had grown too numerous,

sentences.zh: 難於銓選，降旨停止。

translations.literal: selection was difficult, and an edict was issued to stop.
translations.idiomatic: selection had become difficult, and an edict halted them.

sentences.zh: 年來捐納應用之人，將次用完，越數年，必致無捐納之人，而專用科目矣。

translations.literal: In recent years those available from contribution are nearly exhausted; in a few more years there will inevitably be no contributed officials, and only examination graduates will be used.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the pool of purchased officials is nearly exhausted; in a few years there will be none left, and only examination graduates will remain.

sentences.zh: 應酌添捐納事款。

translations.literal: Contribution items should be considered for addition.
translations.idiomatic: Additional purchase categories should be considered.

sentences.zh: 除道、府、同知不許捐納，其通判、知州、知縣及州同、縣丞等，酌議准捐。

translations.literal: Except that circuit intendants, prefects, and sub-prefects were not permitted to contribute; for sub-circuit magistrates, department magistrates, district magistrates, department assistants, and county assistants, permission to contribute was to be deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit intendants, prefects, and sub-prefects were barred from purchase; sub-circuit magistrates, department magistrates, district magistrates, and their deputies were to be considered for approval.

sentences.zh: 」下九卿議行。

translations.literal: " This was referred to the Nine Ministers for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The matter was referred to the Nine Ministers for implementation.

sentences.zh: 十二年，開豫籌糧運例。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, the Henan grain-reserve transport regulations were opened.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 12 (1734), the Henan grain-reserve transport purchase regulations were opened.

sentences.zh: 先是俊秀淮貢得輸資為教職。

translations.literal: Earlier, genteel youths permitted tribute student status could pay funds to become educational officials.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, genteel youths eligible for tribute-student status could pay to obtain educational posts.

sentences.zh: 已，慮異途人員不勝訓迪表率之責，康熙三十三年，令俊秀准貢捐學正、教諭者改縣丞，訓導改主簿。

translations.literal: Later, fearing that irregular-route personnel could not bear the duty of instruction and example, in the thirty-third year of Kangxi those genteel youths permitted tribute who contributed for director of studies or instructor were changed to county assistant, and assistant instructor to registrar.
translations.idiomatic: Later, fearing irregular-route appointees could not bear teaching responsibilities, Kangxi 33 (1694) ordered genteel tribute students who purchased director-of-studies or instructor posts reassigned as county assistants, and assistant instructors as registrars.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，諭「捐納教職，多不通文理少年，以之為學問優長、年高齒長者之師可乎？

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, an edict said: "Purchased educational officials are mostly youths ignorant of letters—can they serve as teachers to those superior in learning and advanced in years?
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 (1723), an edict declared: "Most purchased educational officials are illiterate youths—can they teach men of superior learning and advanced years?

sentences.zh: 」詔改用如前例。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered reversion to the previous regulations.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered reversion to the earlier practice.

sentences.zh: 高宗初元，詔停京、外捐例。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Gaozong's reign, an edict halted capital and provincial contribution regulations.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Qianlong reign, an edict halted purchase regulations in the capital and provinces.

sentences.zh: 乾隆七年，上下江水災，命刑部侍郎周學健、直督高斌往同督、撫辦理。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Qianlong, floods struck the upper and lower Yangzi; Vice Minister of Justice Zhou Xuejian and Zhili Governor-General Gao Bin were ordered to go and handle matters jointly with governors and governors-general.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 7 (1742), floods struck the upper and lower Yangzi; Vice Minister of Justice Zhou Xuejian and Zhili Governor-General Gao Bin were sent to assist governors in relief work.

sentences.zh: 尋合疏言賑務、水利需費浩繁，請仿樂善好施例，出資效力者，量多寡敘職官。

translations.literal: Soon they jointly memorialized that relief and water conservancy required vast expense, requesting to follow the charitable-contribution precedent whereby those who contributed funds according to amount received official ranks.
translations.idiomatic: They soon jointly memorialized that relief and waterworks would cost heavily and requested a charitable-contribution precedent, granting official ranks proportional to donations.

sentences.zh: 詔以京官中、行、評、博以下，外官同知、通判以下，無礙正途，如所請行。

translations.literal: An edict granted that for capital officials from central secretaries through compilers and doctors, and provincial officials from sub-prefects and sub-circuit magistrates downward, without harming the regular route, it should proceed as requested.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved ranks up to central secretaries and compilers in the capital and sub-prefects and sub-circuit magistrates in the provinces, provided the regular route was not harmed.

sentences.zh: 嗣是上下江、直隸、山東、河南屢告災，輒徇臣工請，許開捐例。

translations.literal: Thereafter the upper and lower Yangzi, Zhili, Shandong, and Henan repeatedly reported disasters, and each time ministers' requests were followed to permit opening contribution regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter floods and famine in the Yangzi regions, Zhili, Shandong, and Henan repeatedly led the court to grant ministers' requests to open purchase regulations.

sentences.zh: 十三年，進剿大金川，四川巡撫紀山奏行運米事例，部議運米石抵捐銀二十五兩，納官以是為差。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, advancing against Great Jinchuan, Sichuan Governor Ji Shan memorialized implementing grain-transport regulations; the ministry deliberated that one shi of transported grain equaled twenty-five taels of contribution silver, and contributing officials used this as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 13 (1748), during the campaign against Great Jinchuan, Sichuan Governor Ji Shan proposed grain-transport purchase regulations; the ministry set one shi of transported grain equal to twenty-five taels of silver, which contributors used as the standard.

sentences.zh: 川陝總督張廣泗言：「軍前口糧領折色，石發銀五、六兩。

translations.literal: Sichuan-Shaanxi Governor-General Zhang Guangsi said: "At the front, rations were issued in commuted silver; per shi five or six taels were paid.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan-Shaanxi Governor-General Zhang Guangsi said: "At the front, rations were commuted to silver at five or six taels per shi.

sentences.zh: 事例既開，各員以存米納捐，計貢監納即用同知不過千餘金，即用小京官不過數百金，請令如數交銀，以杜弊端。

translations.literal: Once regulations were open, each official contributed with stored grain; calculating that a tribute student purchasing immediate-appointment sub-prefect cost no more than a thousand-odd in cash, and a junior capital official no more than several hundred, he requested ordering payment in silver at the full amount to stop abuses.
translations.idiomatic: Once regulations opened, officials paid with stored grain; a tribute student buying immediate appointment as sub-prefect cost barely a thousand cash, a junior capital official only a few hundred—he requested requiring full payment in silver to stop abuses.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，再征金川，復開川運例。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year, campaigning against Jinchuan again, Sichuan transport regulations were reopened.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 39 (1774), during the second Jinchuan campaign, Sichuan transport purchase regulations were reopened.

sentences.zh: 惟四庫館謄錄、議敘等職，多靳不令捐納，餘得一體報捐。

translations.literal: Only for Siku Quanshu copying clerks, merit-review posts, and the like, many were stingily not permitted to contribute; the rest could report contributions uniformly.
translations.idiomatic: Only Siku Quanshu copying clerks and merit-review posts were largely barred from purchase; all others could contribute.

sentences.zh: 貢監納道、府例，自雍正五年後，數十年無行者，至是復行。

translations.literal: The regulation for tribute and academy students purchasing circuit and prefectural posts, unused for decades since the fifth year of Yongzheng, was revived at this time.
translations.idiomatic: The rule allowing tribute and academy students to purchase circuit and prefectural posts, dormant since Yongzheng 5, was revived.

sentences.zh: 五十八年，詔曰：「前因軍需、河工，支用浩繁，暫開事例，原屬一時權宜。

translations.literal: In the fifty-eighth year, an edict said: "Previously, because of military supplies and river works, expenditures were vast and regulations were opened temporarily—this was originally a momentary expedient.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 58 (1793), an edict declared: "Purchase regulations were opened temporarily for military and river works needs—an expedient measure only.

sentences.zh: 迄今二十餘年，府庫充盈，並不因停捐稍形支絀。

translations.literal: For more than twenty years until now, the treasury has been full, and stopping contributions has not caused the slightest strain.
translations.idiomatic: For more than twenty years the treasury has remained full, and halting purchases has caused no strain whatsoever.

sentences.zh: 可見捐例竟當不必舉行。

translations.literal: It can be seen that contribution regulations should indeed not be instituted.
translations.idiomatic: It is clear that purchase regulations should not be revived at all.

sentences.zh: 不特慎重名器，亦以嘉惠士林，我子孫當永以為法。

translations.literal: This not only honors prestigious titles but also benefits the scholarly community; our descendants should forever take this as law.
translations.idiomatic: This honors official ranks and benefits the scholarly class; our descendants should treat it as permanent law.

sentences.zh: 倘有以開捐請者，即為言利之臣，當斥而勿用。

translations.literal: If anyone requests opening contributions, he is a minister who speaks of profit and should be rejected and not employed.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who requests reopening purchases is a profit-seeking minister and should be rejected and never employed.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，從戶部侍郎蔣賜棨請，開川楚善後事例，帝慮正途因之壅滯，飭妥議條欸。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing, following Vice Minister of Revenue Jiang Ciqi's request, Sichuan-Huguang pacification regulations were opened; the emperor feared the regular route would be blocked thereby and ordered proper deliberation of provisions.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 3 (1798), following Vice Minister Jiang Ciqi's request, Sichuan-Huguang pacification purchase regulations were opened; fearing blockage of the regular route, the emperor ordered careful drafting of provisions.

sentences.zh: 尋議：「京官郎中、員外郎，外官道、府，有理事親民之責，未便濫予登進。

translations.literal: Soon it was deliberated: "Capital officials of director and vice director rank, and provincial circuit and prefectural officials, bear responsibility for governing affairs and caring for the people—it is not fitting to grant advancement indiscriminately.
translations.idiomatic: Soon deliberation concluded: "Directors and vice directors in the capital and circuit and prefectural officials in the provinces bear governing responsibilities and should not receive indiscriminate advancement.

sentences.zh: 進士，舉人，恩、拔、副、優、歲貢，始許捐納。

translations.literal: Only jinshi, juren, and en, ba, fu, you, sui tribute graduates were permitted to contribute.
translations.idiomatic: Only jinshi, juren, and various tribute graduates were permitted to purchase offices.

sentences.zh: 非正途候補、候選正印人員，亦得遞捐。

translations.literal: Those awaiting appointment or candidacy for chief posts outside the regular route could also contribute in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Those awaiting appointment outside the regular route for chief posts could also purchase in succession.

sentences.zh: 現任、應補、候選小京官、佐貳，止准以應升之項捐納。

translations.literal: Incumbent, awaiting supplementary appointment, and candidate junior capital officials and deputies were permitted to contribute only for items they were eligible to be promoted to.
translations.idiomatic: Incumbent, awaiting appointment, and candidate junior capital officials and deputies could purchase only ranks they were eligible to attain.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was followed.
translations.idiomatic: " The regulations were adopted.

sentences.zh: 嗣以河屢決，續開衡工、豫東、武陟等例。

translations.literal: Later, because rivers repeatedly burst their banks, Heng River works, eastern Henan, Wuzhi, and other regulations were opened in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as rivers repeatedly breached their banks, Heng River works, eastern Henan, Wuzhi, and other purchase regulations were opened.

sentences.zh: 十一年，定捐納道、府，系曾任知府、同知、直隸州知州并州、縣正印等官加捐，及現任京職，堪勝繁缺者，許以繁簡各缺選用。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, it was fixed that purchased circuit and prefectural posts were for those who had served as prefect, sub-prefect, Zhili department magistrate, or chief county and department posts and contributed further, and incumbent capital officials capable of demanding posts—both were permitted selection for demanding and minor vacancies respectively.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 11 (1806), purchased circuit and prefectural posts were limited to former prefects, sub-prefects, and chief county officials who made additional contributions, and to incumbent capital officials capable of demanding posts—each assigned to demanding or minor vacancies accordingly.

sentences.zh: 其貢監初捐，及現任京職僅堪簡缺，並外任佐雜等官遞捐者，專以簡缺選用。

translations.literal: Those making initial contribution as tribute or academy students, incumbent capital officials capable only of minor vacancies, and provincial deputies and miscellaneous officials contributing in succession were selected exclusively for minor vacancies.
translations.idiomatic: Initial contributors among tribute and academy students, capital officials fit only for minor posts, and provincial deputies purchasing in succession were assigned exclusively to minor vacancies.

sentences.zh: 宣宗、文宗御極之初，首停捐例，一時以為美談。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xuanzong's and Wenzong's reigns, contribution regulations were first halted—for a time this was praised as fine policy.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Daoguang and Xianfeng reigns, purchase regulations were halted first—praised at the time as enlightened policy.

sentences.zh: 自道光七年開酌增常例，而籌備經費，豫工遵捐，順天、兩廣及三省新捐，次第議行。

translations.literal: From the seventh year of Daoguang, adjusted standing regulations were opened; then fund-raising, Henan works compliance contributions, Shuntian, Liang-Guang, and three-province new contributions were deliberated and implemented in turn.
translations.idiomatic: From Daoguang 7 (1827) adjusted standing regulations opened, followed in turn by fund-raising, Henan works compliance, Shuntian, Liang-Guang, and three-province purchase regulations.

sentences.zh: 其時捐例多沿舊制，惟於推廣捐例中准貢生捐中書，豫工例中准增、附捐教職而已。

translations.literal: At that time contribution regulations mostly followed old institutions; only in extended regulations were tribute licentiates permitted to purchase Secretariat drafter, and in Henan works regulations supplemental and attached students permitted to purchase educational posts.
translations.idiomatic: Most regulations followed old practice; only the extended regulations allowed tribute licentiates to purchase Secretariat drafter posts, and the Henan works regulations allowed supplemental students to purchase educational posts.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，以給事中汪元方言，罷增、附捐教職，其已選補者，不許濫膺保薦。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng, on Supervising Secretary Wang Yuanfang's memorial, supplemental and attached student purchase of educational posts was abolished; those already selected were not permitted indiscriminate recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 1 (1851), on Supervising Secretary Wang Yuanfang's memorial, supplemental students' purchase of educational posts was abolished, and those already appointed were barred from indiscriminate recommendation.

sentences.zh: 是年特開籌餉事例；

translations.literal: That year special fund-raising regulations were opened;
translations.idiomatic: That year special fund-raising purchase regulations were opened;

sentences.zh: 明年，續頒寬籌軍餉章程。

translations.literal: the next year, expanded military-fund-raising regulations were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: the next year expanded military-fund-raising regulations followed.

sentences.zh: 九年，復推廣捐例。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, contribution regulations were extended again.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 9 (1859), purchase regulations were extended again.

sentences.zh: 時軍興餉絀，捐例繁多，無復限制，仕途蕪雜日益甚。

translations.literal: At the time war had begun and supplies were short; contribution regulations were numerous without limit, and the official path grew ever more tangled.
translations.idiomatic: War had begun and funds ran short; purchase regulations multiplied without limit, and the official career path grew ever more chaotic.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，御史裘德俊請令商賈不得納正印實官，以虛銜雜職為限。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, Censor Qiu Dejun requested that merchants not be permitted to purchase substantive chief posts, limiting them to nominal ranks and miscellaneous posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 1 (1862), Censor Qiu Dejun requested barring merchants from purchasing substantive chief posts, limiting them to nominal ranks and miscellaneous posts.

sentences.zh: 下部議行。

translations.literal: This was referred to the ministry for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated and implemented the proposal.

sentences.zh: 尋部臣言捐生觀望，有礙餉需，詔仍舊制。

translations.literal: Soon ministry officials said contributors were watching and waiting, harming supply needs; an edict restored the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Soon ministry officials reported that contributors were holding back, harming military funds; an edict restored the old system.

sentences.zh: 四年，山東巡撫閻敬銘言：「各省捐輸減成，按之籌餉定例，不及十成之三。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Shandong Governor Yan Jingming said: "Provincial contributions are reduced in scale; compared with fund-raising fixed regulations, they reach less than three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 4 (1865), Shandong Governor Yan Jingming said: "Provincial contributions are heavily discounted—less than thirty percent of the fund-raising standard.

sentences.zh: 彼輩以官為貿易，略一侵吞錢糧，已逾原捐之數。

translations.literal: They treat office as trade; a slight embezzlement of taxes and grain already exceeds their original contribution.
translations.idiomatic: They treat office as commerce; slight embezzlement of taxes and grain already exceeds their original payment.

sentences.zh: 明效輸將，暗虧帑項。

translations.literal: Openly they appear to contribute, but secretly they drain the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: They appear to contribute openly while secretly draining the treasury.

sentences.zh: 請將道、府、州、縣照籌餉例減二成，專於京銅局報捐。

translations.literal: He requested that circuit, prefectural, departmental, and county posts follow fund-raising regulations with a twenty-percent reduction, reporting contributions exclusively at the Beijing Copper Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He requested circuit, prefectural, departmental, and county posts follow fund-raising rates with a twenty-percent reduction, reporting exclusively to the Beijing Copper Bureau.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was followed.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 時內則京捐局，外則甘捐、皖捐、黔捐，設局遍各行省。

translations.literal: At the time, within there was the Beijing contribution bureau; without, Gansu, Anhui, and Guizhou contributions—bureaus were established in every province.
translations.idiomatic: Within the capital the Beijing contribution bureau operated; outside, Gansu, Anhui, and Guizhou bureaus—and similar offices in every province.

sentences.zh: 侵蝕、勒派、私行減折，諸弊並作。

translations.literal: Embezzlement, forced levies, and private reductions in scale—all abuses arose together.
translations.idiomatic: Embezzlement, forced levies, and private discounting flourished together.

sentences.zh: 光緒初，議者謂乾隆間常例，每歲貢監封典、雜職捐收，約三百萬。

translations.literal: Early in Guangxu, deliberators said that under Qianlong standing regulations, annual collections from tribute students, enfeoffment, and miscellaneous posts totaled about three million.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Guangxu era, critics noted that under Qianlong standing regulations, annual collections from tribute students, enfeoffment titles, and miscellaneous posts had totaled about three million taels.

sentences.zh: 今捐例折減，歲入轉不及百五十萬。

translations.literal: Now with contribution regulations discounted, annual receipts fell short of one and a half million.
translations.idiomatic: With purchase rates discounted, annual receipts now fell below one and a half million.

sentences.zh: 名器重，雖虛銜亦覺其榮，多費而有所不惜。

translations.literal: When prestigious titles were weighty, even nominal ranks felt honorable, and people spent lavishly without regret.
translations.idiomatic: When prestigious ranks carried weight, even nominal titles felt honorable, and people spent freely without regret.

sentences.zh: 名器輕，則實職不難驟獲，減數而未必樂輸。

translations.literal: When prestigious titles were light, substantive posts were not hard to obtain quickly; with reduced rates, people might not gladly contribute.
translations.idiomatic: When ranks lost their prestige, substantive posts became easy to obtain; lower rates did not necessarily encourage giving.

sentences.zh: 所得無幾，所傷實多。

translations.literal: The gain was slight; the harm was substantial.
translations.idiomatic: The revenue gained was slight; the damage to governance was substantial.

sentences.zh: 停捐為便。

translations.literal: Stopping contributions was expedient.
translations.idiomatic: Halting purchases was the better course.

sentences.zh: 時復有言捐官宜考試，花翎及在任、候選等捐宜停者。

translations.literal: From time to time there were also proposals that purchased officials should take examinations, and that peacock-feather plumes and contributions by incumbents and candidates should be halted.
translations.idiomatic: Proposals also circulated that purchased officials should take examinations and that peacock plumes and contributions by incumbents and candidates should be stopped.

sentences.zh: 輒下部議。

translations.literal: Each time these were referred to the ministry for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Each proposal was referred to the ministries for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 五年，帝以捐例無補餉需，實傷吏道，明詔停止。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the emperor, holding that contribution regulations did not aid military funds and truly harmed official conduct, issued an explicit edict to stop them.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 5, the emperor declared that purchase regulations did not aid military funds but harmed official conduct, and issued an explicit edict halting them.

sentences.zh: 未幾，海疆多故，十年，開海防捐，如籌餉例，減二成核收，常例捐數並核減。

translations.literal: Before long, the maritime frontier had many troubles; in the tenth year, coastal defense contributions were opened, like fund-raising regulations with twenty-percent reduction in collection; standing regulation amounts were also reduced in verification.
translations.idiomatic: Soon maritime troubles multiplied; in Guangxu 10 coastal defense purchases opened, following fund-raising rates with a twenty-percent reduction, and standing regulation amounts were likewise reduced.

sentences.zh: 是時台灣甫開實官捐。

translations.literal: At this time Taiwan had just opened substantive-office contributions.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan had just opened purchase of substantive offices.

sentences.zh: 他如四川按糧津貼捐，順天直隸、河南、浙江、安徽、湖北各賑捐，戶部廣東軍火捐，福建洋藥、茶捐，雲南米捐，自海防例行，惟川捐如舊，餘或並或罷。

translations.literal: Others such as Sichuan grain-surtax contributions, relief contributions in Shuntian-Zhili, Henan, Zhejiang, Anhui, and Hubei, Ministry of Revenue Guangdong ordnance contributions, Fujian opium and tea contributions, and Yunnan rice contributions—all followed the coastal defense regulations except Sichuan, which remained as before; the rest were merged or abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Other schemes followed—Sichuan grain surtaxes, relief contributions in Shuntian-Zhili, Henan, Zhejiang, Anhui, and Hubei, Guangdong ordnance funds, Fujian opium and tea levies, Yunnan rice contributions—all modeled on coastal defense regulations except Sichuan's, which continued unchanged; the rest were merged or abolished.

sentences.zh: 十三年，河南武陟，鄭州沁、黃兩河漫決。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Wuzhi in Henan and the Qin and Yellow Rivers at Zhengzhou burst their banks.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 13, the Qin and Yellow Rivers burst their banks at Wuzhi and Zhengzhou in Henan.

sentences.zh: 御史周天霖、李士錕先後請開鄭工例，以濟要工。

translations.literal: Censors Zhou Tianlin and Li Shijin successively requested opening Zhengzhou works regulations to aid urgent projects.
translations.idiomatic: Censors Zhou Tianlin and Li Shijin successively requested opening Zhengzhou river-works purchase regulations to fund urgent repairs.

sentences.zh: 部議停海防捐，開鄭工捐。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated to halt coastal defense contributions and open Zhengzhou works contributions.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry halted coastal defense purchases and opened Zhengzhou works purchases.

sentences.zh: 十五年，籌辦海軍，復罷鄭工，開海防新捐。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, preparing the navy, Zhengzhou works were abolished again and new coastal defense contributions were opened.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 15, to fund the navy, Zhengzhou works purchases were halted and new coastal defense purchases opened.

sentences.zh: 新捐屢展限，行之十餘年。

translations.literal: The new contributions were repeatedly extended in deadline and operated for more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: The new purchases were repeatedly extended and operated for more than a decade.

sentences.zh: 二十六、七年間，江寧籌餉，秦、晉實官捐，順直善後賑捐，次第舉辦。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth and twenty-seventh years, Jiangning fund-raising, Qin-Jin substantive-office contributions, and Shuntian-Zhili pacification relief contributions were launched in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Around Guangxu 26–27, Jiangning fund-raising, Qin-Jin substantive-office purchases, and Shuntian-Zhili pacification relief contributions were launched in turn.

sentences.zh: 江寧順直捐視新海防例，秦、晉捐但獎五品以下實官。

translations.literal: Jiangning and Shuntian-Zhili contributions followed the new coastal defense regulations; Qin-Jin contributions awarded only substantive offices of fifth rank and below.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangning and Shuntian-Zhili purchases followed the new coastal defense rates; Qin-Jin purchases awarded only substantive offices of fifth rank and below.

sentences.zh: 庚子變後，帝銳意圖治，言者多謂捐納非善政，詔即停止。

translations.literal: After the Gengzi upheaval, the emperor was keen to govern well; many said purchase of office was not good policy, and an edict immediately halted it.
translations.idiomatic: After the Boxer crisis of 1900, the emperor sought thorough reform; many declared purchase of office bad policy, and an edict immediately halted it.

sentences.zh: 然報效敘官，舊捐移獎，且繼續行之。

translations.literal: Yet rewarding service with official rank, transferring old contributions as awards, and the like continued to be practiced.
translations.idiomatic: Yet rewarding service with official rank, transferring old contributions as awards, and similar practices continued.

sentences.zh: 但有停捐之名而已。

translations.literal: There was only the name of halting contributions.
translations.idiomatic: Halting purchases existed in name only.

sentences.zh: 武職捐，雍正初惟納千、把總。

translations.literal: Military contributions: early in Yongzheng only platoon and company commanders could be purchased.
translations.idiomatic: Military purchases: early in the Yongzheng era only platoon and company commanders could be bought.

sentences.zh: 乾隆九年，直賑捐有納衛守備者。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Qianlong, Zhili relief contributions included those purchasing garrison commandant posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 9, Zhili relief purchases included garrison commandant posts.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，川運例，參、游、都、守始得遞捐。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year, under Sichuan transport regulations, brigade commanders, colonels, brigadiers, and commandants could contribute in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 39, under Sichuan transport regulations, brigade commanders through commandants could purchase in succession.

sentences.zh: 但武生、監生捐止都司。

translations.literal: But military students and academy students purchasing were limited to brigadier.
translations.idiomatic: Military students and academy students, however, could purchase only up to brigadier.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，川楚善後例，武營捐納，略如川運。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing, under Sichuan-Huguang pacification regulations, military camp contributions were much like Sichuan transport.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 3, under Sichuan-Huguang pacification regulations, military purchases followed the Sichuan transport model.

sentences.zh: 同治五年，閩浙總督左宗棠言：「閩省武營捐班太多，應嚴加區別，以肅軍政。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tongzhi, Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General Zuo Zongtang said: "Fujian military camp contribution quotas are too numerous; strict distinction should be made to rectify military administration.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 5, Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General Zuo Zongtang said: "Fujian has too many military purchase quotas; they should be strictly distinguished to restore military discipline.

sentences.zh: 」並請罷武職捐，從之。

translations.literal: " He also requested abolishing military contributions; this was followed.
translations.idiomatic: " He also requested abolishing military purchases; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十一年，新海防例展限，議增武職捐。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Guangxu, when new coastal defense regulations were extended, increased military contributions were deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 21, when new coastal defense regulations were extended, increased military purchases were considered.

sentences.zh: 於揀發外別立一班，俾捐輸踴躍。

translations.literal: A separate quota was established apart from selection and dispatch, so that contributors would compete eagerly.
translations.idiomatic: A separate quota was established beyond regular selection, to encourage eager contributions.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，兵部奏：「開捐十年，入款僅十餘萬，無裨國帑，有兒營伍。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, the Ministry of War memorialized: "Contributions have been open ten years; receipts are only a hundred-odd thousand taels, of no benefit to the national treasury, and harmful to military units.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 31, the Ministry of War memorialized: "Purchases have been open ten years; receipts total barely a hundred thousand taels, benefiting the treasury not at all and harming military units.

sentences.zh: 請將實官、虛銜捐復翎銜、封典一切停罷。

translations.literal: We request that substantive offices, nominal ranks, contribution restoration, plumes and insignia, and enfeoffment—all be completely halted.
translations.idiomatic: We request halting all substantive offices, nominal ranks, restoration purchases, plumes, and enfeoffment titles.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: " Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 捐例初開，慮其弊也，嘗設為限制，往往不久而其法壞。

translations.literal: When contribution regulations were first opened, fearing their abuses, restrictions were often set—but before long the regulations broke down.
translations.idiomatic: When purchase regulations first opened, restrictions were set to curb abuse—but they often broke down within a short time.

sentences.zh: 康熙十八年，定捐納官到任三年稱職者，具題升轉，不稱職者題參。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Kangxi, it was fixed that contributed officials after three years in office, if competent, were to be memorialized for promotion; if incompetent, impeached.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 18, it was decreed that purchased officials after three years, if competent, would be memorialized for promotion; if not, impeached.

sentences.zh: 然疆吏罕有以不職上聞者。

translations.literal: Yet frontier officials rarely reported incompetence upward.
translations.idiomatic: Yet provincial officials rarely reported incompetence to the court.

sentences.zh: 已，令道、府以下捐銀者免具題，照常升轉。

translations.literal: Later, those below circuit and prefect who contributed silver were exempted from memorials and promoted as usual.
translations.idiomatic: Later, contributors below circuit and prefect rank were exempted from the memorial requirement and promoted as usual.

sentences.zh: 左都御史徐元文言：「國家大體所關，惟賢不肖之辨。

translations.literal: Left Censor-in-Chief Xu Yuanwen said: "What concerns the great principles of the state is only distinguishing the worthy from the unworthy.
translations.idiomatic: Left Censor-in-Chief Xu Yuanwen said: "The state's fundamental principle is distinguishing the worthy from the unworthy.

sentences.zh: 三年具題，所以使賢者勸，不肖者懼。

translations.literal: The three-year memorial exists to encourage the worthy and make the unworthy fear.
translations.idiomatic: The three-year memorial encourages the worthy and makes the unworthy fear.

sentences.zh: 輸銀免具題，是金多者與稱職同科。

translations.literal: Paying silver to avoid memorials places those with more gold in the same category as the competent.
translations.idiomatic: Paying silver to avoid the memorial equates wealth with competence.

sentences.zh: 此曹以現任之官營輸入之計，何所不至？

translations.literal: These people, using their incumbent posts to scheme for contributions—what would they not do?
translations.idiomatic: These men, scheming to pay from their incumbent salaries—what would they not stoop to?

sentences.zh: 急宜停止。

translations.literal: This should be stopped urgently.
translations.idiomatic: This practice must be stopped at once.

sentences.zh: 順治間，准貢、例監出身官不得升補正印。

translations.literal: During Shunzhi, officials from permitted tribute and purchased academy backgrounds could not be promoted to chief posts.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shunzhi era, officials from permitted-tribute and purchased-academy backgrounds could not be promoted to chief posts.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年，定為保舉之法，各途出身官，經該堂官及督、撫保舉稱職者，升京官及正印。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Kangxi, the recommendation method was fixed: officials of all backgrounds, if recommended as competent by their department heads and governors, were promoted to capital posts and chief appointments.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6, a recommendation system was established: officials of all backgrounds recommended as competent by department heads and governors could rise to capital posts and chief appointments.

sentences.zh: 無保舉者，升佐貳、雜職。

translations.literal: Those without recommendation were promoted to deputies and miscellaneous posts.
translations.idiomatic: Those without recommendation were promoted only to deputies and miscellaneous posts.

sentences.zh: 三十年，大軍征噶爾丹，戶部奏行輸送草豆例，准異途人員捐免保舉。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, the great army campaigned against Galdan; the Ministry of Revenue memorialized implementing forage-transport regulations, permitting irregular-route personnel to purchase exemption from recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 30, during the campaign against Galdan, the Ministry of Revenue opened forage-transport regulations, allowing irregular-route officials to purchase exemption from recommendation.

sentences.zh: 御史陸隴其言：「捐納一事，不得已而暫開，許捐免保舉，則與正途無異。

translations.literal: Censor Lu Longqi said: "The matter of contribution was opened temporarily as a last resort; permitting purchase of exemption from recommendation makes it no different from the regular route.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Lu Longqi said: "Purchase of office was opened only as a last resort; allowing purchase of exemption from recommendation makes it no different from the regular route.

sentences.zh: 且督、撫保舉之人，必清廉方為合例。

translations.literal: Moreover, those recommended by governors must be incorrupt to conform to regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, governors may recommend only officials who are incorrupt.

sentences.zh: 保舉可捐免，是清廉可納資得也。

translations.literal: If recommendation can be purchased exempt, then integrity can be obtained by paying funds.
translations.idiomatic: If recommendation can be purchased, then integrity can be bought with money.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「督、撫於捐納人員，有遲至數年不保舉亦不糾劾。

translations.literal: " He also said: "Governors toward contributed personnel sometimes delay recommendation for years without impeachment either.
translations.idiomatic: " He also said: "Governors often delay recommending purchased officials for years without impeaching them either.

sentences.zh: 乞敕部通稽捐納官到任三年無保舉者，開缺休致。

translations.literal: He begged ordering the ministry to investigate generally: contributed officials without recommendation after three years in office should have their posts opened and retire.
translations.idiomatic: He requested that the ministry investigate all purchased officials without recommendation after three years and retire them from office.

sentences.zh: 」疏下九卿，議：「捐免保舉，無礙正途。

translations.literal: " The memorial was sent to the Nine Ministers, who deliberated: "Purchasing exemption from recommendation does not harm the regular route.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial went to the Nine Ministers, who ruled: "Purchasing exemption from recommendation does not harm the regular route.

sentences.zh: 若三年無保舉即休致，則營求保舉益甚，應毋庸議」。

translations.literal: If lack of recommendation after three years leads to retirement, scheming for recommendation would increase further; this need not be deliberated."
translations.idiomatic: If three years without recommendation meant retirement, scheming for recommendation would only increase; the proposal need not be adopted."

sentences.zh: 隴其持之益堅，廷議隴其不計緩急輕重，浮詞粉飾，致捐生觀望，遲誤軍機，擬奪職。

translations.literal: Longqi held his position ever more firmly; the court deliberated that Longqi, disregarding urgency and weight, used empty words and ornament, causing contributors to hesitate and delaying military affairs, and proposed stripping his office.
translations.idiomatic: Longqi held firm; the court ruled he had disregarded urgency, used empty rhetoric, caused contributors to hesitate, and delayed military affairs, and proposed stripping his office.

sentences.zh: 帝特宥之。

translations.literal: The emperor specially pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor specially pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 自是吏員例監出身者，欲升補或捐納京、外正印官、必先捐免保舉，惟准貢獨否。

translations.literal: From this, clerical officials of purchased academy background wishing promotion or to purchase capital or provincial chief posts had first to purchase exemption from recommendation; only permitted tribute graduates were exempt.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter clerical officials from purchased-academy backgrounds seeking promotion or purchasing chief posts in the capital or provinces had first to purchase exemption from recommendation; only permitted-tribute graduates were exempt.

sentences.zh: 初，納歲貢者同正途，故捐免保舉例開，貢監雖同一捐納，而軒輊殊甚。

translations.literal: Initially, annual tribute contributors were treated like the regular route; when exemption-from-recommendation regulations opened, tribute and academy students, though both contributing, were treated very unequally.
translations.idiomatic: Initially annual tribute graduates were treated like the regular route; when exemption purchases opened, tribute and academy students—though both purchased offices—were treated very unequally.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十六年，部議御史王啟緒奏豫工例內，捐貢納京、外正印官，捐免保舉，如例監例。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Qianlong, the ministry deliberated on Censor Wang Qixu's memorial that within Henan works regulations, tribute contributors purchasing capital or provincial chief posts should purchase exemption from recommendation like purchased academy students.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 26, the ministry adopted Censor Wang Qixu's proposal that within Henan works regulations, tribute graduates purchasing chief posts must purchase exemption from recommendation like academy students.

sentences.zh: 先納官者，補行捐免。

translations.literal: Those who had purchased office earlier were to make the exemption purchase retroactively.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had purchased earlier had to buy exemption retroactively.

sentences.zh: 不原者，以佐貳改補。

translations.literal: Those unwilling were reassigned to deputy posts.
translations.idiomatic: Those unwilling were reassigned to deputy posts.

sentences.zh: 成例為一變矣。

translations.literal: Established precedent was thus altered.
translations.idiomatic: Established precedent was thus overturned.

sentences.zh: 漢軍捐納官，非經考試，不得銓選，如漢官保舉例。

translations.literal: Bannermen contributed officials, without passing examination, could not be selected—like Han officials under the recommendation rule.
translations.idiomatic: Banner contributed officials, without passing examination, could not be selected—like Han officials under the recommendation rule.

sentences.zh: 康熙間，並准捐免。

translations.literal: During Kangxi, purchase exemption was also permitted.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kangxi era, purchase exemption was also permitted.

sentences.zh: 六十一年，帝以捐納部員補主事未久即升員郎，外官道、府亦然，飭議試俸之法。

translations.literal: In the sixty-first year, the emperor, because contributed ministry staff were promoted from section chief to vice director shortly after appointment, and provincial circuit and prefectural officials likewise, ordered deliberation on probationary-salary methods.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 61, because purchased ministry staff were promoted from section chief to vice director almost immediately, and circuit and prefectural officials likewise, the emperor ordered deliberation on probationary-salary rules.

sentences.zh: 尋議郎中、道、府以下，小京官、佐雜以上，於現任內試俸三年，題咨實授，方許升轉，從之。

translations.literal: Soon it was deliberated that from directors and circuit and prefectural officials downward, and from junior capital officials and deputies upward, three years of probationary salary in current post, then memorial for substantive appointment, before promotion was permitted; this was followed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon it was decreed that directors, circuit and prefectural officials, junior capital officials, and deputies must serve three years on probationary salary before substantive appointment and promotion; the rule was adopted.

sentences.zh: 乾隆間，試俸復得捐免。

translations.literal: During Qianlong, probationary salary could again be purchased exempt.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong era, probationary salary could again be purchased away.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，戶部奏請保舉、考試、試俸、捐免例，列入常捐。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year, the Ministry of Revenue memorialized requesting that recommendation, examination, probationary salary, and purchase-exemption regulations be listed in standing contributions.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 41, the Ministry of Revenue requested listing recommendation, examination, probationary salary, and purchase-exemption items in standing contributions.

sentences.zh: 限制之法，至是悉弛。

translations.literal: Restrictive methods were by then entirely relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: By then all restrictive measures had been entirely relaxed.

sentences.zh: 官吏緣事罷譴，降革留任，非數年無過，不得開復。

translations.literal: Officials dismissed or punished for affairs, demoted or dismissed but retained, could not be restored without several years without fault.
translations.idiomatic: Officials dismissed, demoted, or dismissed-but-retained could not be restored without several years without fault.

sentences.zh: 康熙間，大同賑飢，部議京察、大計罷黜者，悉予捐復。

translations.literal: During Kangxi, for Datong famine relief, the ministry deliberated granting contribution restoration to all dismissed in capital and provincial evaluations.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kangxi era, for Datong famine relief, the ministry proposed granting restoration by purchase to all officials dismissed in capital and provincial evaluations.

sentences.zh: 徐元文力言不可。

translations.literal: Xu Yuanwen strongly said this was impermissible.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yuanwen strongly objected.

sentences.zh: 議遂寢。

translations.literal: The deliberation was then shelved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was shelved.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，河道總督于成龍以黃、運兩河，工費繁鉅，請仿陝西賑飢例開捐，革職、年老、患疾、休致人員得捐復。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, River Conservancy Governor Yu Chenglong, because the Yellow and Grand Canal works costs were vast, requested opening contributions modeled on Shaanxi famine relief, permitting dismissed, aged, ill, and retired personnel to restore by contribution.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 33, River Conservancy Governor Yu Chenglong, citing vast costs for Yellow River and Grand Canal works, requested purchase regulations modeled on Shaanxi famine relief, allowing dismissed, aged, ill, and retired officials to restore by purchase.

sentences.zh: 帝面諭捐納稱貸者多，非朘削無以償逋負，事不可行。

translations.literal: The emperor said in person that many contributed officials were in debt; without embezzlement they could not repay arrears—the matter could not proceed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said in person that many purchased officials were in debt and could repay only by embezzlement—the proposal could not proceed.

sentences.zh: 尚書薩穆哈等議成龍懷私妄奏，擬褫職，得旨從寬留任。

translations.literal: Minister Samuha and others deliberated that Chenglong had private motives in a reckless memorial and proposed stripping his office; an edict leniently retained him in post.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Samuha and others ruled Chenglong had acted from private motives and proposed stripping his office; an edict leniently retained him.

sentences.zh: 乾隆九年，直賑捐，部議捐復條款，京察、大計及犯私罪者，降調人員，無論是否因公，及比照六法條例，武職軍政糾參及貪婪者，不準捐復。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Qianlong, for Zhili relief contributions, the ministry deliberated restoration terms: those dismissed in capital and provincial evaluations, private offenders, demoted personnel whether or not for public business, and by comparison to the six disciplinary statutes; military personnel impeached in military evaluations and the greedy were not permitted restoration by contribution.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 9, for Zhili relief purchases, the ministry set restoration terms: officials dismissed in evaluations, private offenders, demoted personnel, and those compared to the six disciplinary statutes; military officials impeached in military evaluations and the greedy could not restore by purchase.

sentences.zh: 因公罣誤無餘罪，悉得捐復。

translations.literal: Those faulted for public business without further crime could all restore by contribution.
translations.idiomatic: Those faulted for public business without further crimes could all restore by purchase.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，帝念降革留任人員，因公處分，輒停升轉，詔許捐復。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year, the emperor, mindful that demoted-and-retained personnel were often halted in promotion for public-business punishments, decreed permitting restoration by contribution.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 35, mindful that demoted-and-retained officials were often blocked from promotion for public-business punishments, the emperor decreed permitting restoration by purchase.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，川運例增進士、舉人捐復原資例。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year, Sichuan transport regulations added jinshi and juren restoration of original seniority.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 39, Sichuan transport regulations added restoration of original seniority for jinshi and juren.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，定革職、降調官，分段承修南運河工程捐復例。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year, regulations were fixed for dismissed and demoted officials to undertake sections of the Southern Grand Canal works for restoration by contribution.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 48, dismissed and demoted officials were assigned sections of Southern Grand Canal works for restoration by purchase.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，川楚善後，推廣其例，凡常捐不準捐復人員，酌核情節，得酌加報捐。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing, for Sichuan-Huguang pacification, the precedent was extended: all normally ineligible for restoration could have circumstances weighed and report additional contributions as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 3, for Sichuan-Huguang pacification, the precedent was extended: normally ineligible officials could have circumstances weighed and make additional contributions.

sentences.zh: 奉旨，降革除犯六法外，因公情節尚輕人員，得加倍捐復。

translations.literal: By imperial order, apart from those guilty under the six statutes, demoted and dismissed personnel whose public-business circumstances were still light could restore at double contribution.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial order, apart from those guilty under the six statutes, demoted officials whose public-business faults were minor could restore at double the standard rate.

sentences.zh: 大計劾參，有疾休致，調治就痊，及特旨降革留任限年開復人員，加十分之五捐復。

translations.literal: Those impeached in provincial evaluation, retired for illness and recovered, and those demoted-and-retained by special edict with fixed years for restoration, paid an additional fifty percent for restoration.
translations.idiomatic: Officials impeached in provincial evaluation, retired for illness and recovered, and those demoted-but-retained under special edict paid an additional fifty percent for restoration.

sentences.zh: 十年，部臣疏請於常例捐復外，增文、武大員捐復革職留任例。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, ministry officials memorialized requesting, beyond standing restoration, to add civil and military senior officials' restoration for dismissed-but-retained posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 10, ministry officials requested adding restoration for dismissed-but-retained senior civil and military officials beyond standing regulations.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「大員身罣吏議應罷斥，經改革職留任，開復有一定年限。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Senior officials subject to personnel censure should be dismissed; after demotion and retention in post, restoration has a fixed term.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Senior officials subject to censure should be dismissed; after demotion and retention, restoration has a fixed term.

sentences.zh: 若甫罹重譴，即可捐復，此例一開，亳無畏忌。

translations.literal: If they have just suffered heavy censure yet can immediately restore by contribution, once this precedent opens there will be no fear at all.
translations.idiomatic: If they could restore by purchase immediately after heavy censure, once this precedent opened there would be no restraint whatsoever.

sentences.zh: 有資者脫然為無過之人，無資者日久不能開復。

translations.literal: Those with resources would suddenly become faultless; those without resources could not be restored even after long time.
translations.idiomatic: The wealthy would instantly become blameless; the poor could not be restored even after long years.

sentences.zh: 殊失政體。

translations.literal: This greatly violates proper governance.
translations.idiomatic: This would grossly violate proper governance.

sentences.zh: 」不允行。

translations.literal: " It was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was rejected.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，王、大臣等議寬籌軍餉。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng, princes and grand ministers deliberated expanded military fund-raising.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 2, princes and grand ministers deliberated expanded military fund-raising.

sentences.zh: 凡降革不準捐復人員，除實犯贓私外，餘准加倍半捐復。

translations.literal: All demoted and dismissed personnel normally ineligible for restoration, apart from actual embezzlement and private gain, were permitted restoration at one and a half times the rate.
translations.idiomatic: All normally ineligible demoted and dismissed officials, apart from actual embezzlement, were permitted restoration at one and a half times the rate.

sentences.zh: 降革一、二品文、武官，向不在捐復之列者，許捐復原官頂帶，允行。

translations.literal: First- and second-rank civil and military officials demoted and dismissed, who had never been in the restoration list, were permitted to restore original rank insignia; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: First- and second-rank civil and military officials previously ineligible for restoration were permitted to restore their original rank insignia; this was approved.

sentences.zh: 但飭一、二品大員捐復原銜須請旨。

translations.literal: But first- and second-rank senior officials restoring original rank had to request imperial approval.
translations.idiomatic: But first- and second-rank officials restoring original rank required imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 嗣復推廣，文職京察、大計六法，武職軍政被劾，無奸贓情罪，亦許捐復原銜。

translations.literal: Later this was extended again: civil officials under capital evaluation and provincial evaluation six statutes, and military officials impeached in military evaluation without corruption, were also permitted to restore original rank by contribution.
translations.idiomatic: Later this was extended: civil officials under the six evaluation statutes and military officials impeached without corruption were also permitted to restore original rank by purchase.

sentences.zh: 終清世踵行，不復更也。

translations.literal: Through the end of the Qing it was followed without further change.
translations.idiomatic: This practice continued through the end of the Qing without further change.

sentences.zh: 捐納官或非捐納官，於本班上輸資若干，俾班次較優，銓補加速，謂之花樣。

translations.literal: Contributed officials or non-contributed officials, paying a certain sum on their quota to make their quota rank higher and accelerate selection and appointment, was called patterned contribution.
translations.idiomatic: Whether purchased officials or not, paying extra on one's quota to gain priority in selection and faster appointment was called a patterned contribution.

sentences.zh: 康熙十三年，知縣得納先用、即用班，工部侍郎田六善極言其弊，謂宜停止。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Kangxi, district magistrates could purchase prior-use and immediate-use quotas; Vice Minister of Works Tian Liushan spoke forcefully of the abuses and said they should be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 13, district magistrates could purchase prior-use and immediate-use quotas; Vice Minister of Works Tian Liushan forcefully denounced the abuse and urged stopping it.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，戶部議行輸送草豆例，台臣請增應升、先用捐。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, the Ministry of Revenue deliberated implementing forage-transport regulations; censorial officials requested adding promotion-eligible and prior-use contributions.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 33, the Ministry of Revenue implemented forage-transport regulations; censors requested adding promotion-eligible and prior-use purchase categories.

sentences.zh: 御史陸機言：「前此有納先用一例，正途為之壅滯。

translations.literal: Censor Lu Ji said: "Previously there was a prior-use purchase regulation, and the regular route was blocked thereby.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Lu Ji said: "A prior-use purchase regulation had previously blocked the regular route.

sentences.zh: 皇上灼見其弊，久經停止。

translations.literal: The emperor clearly saw its abuses and had long since stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had clearly seen its harm and long since halted it.

sentences.zh: 納先用者，大都奔兢躁進。

translations.literal: Those purchasing prior use were mostly eager and impatient for advancement.
translations.idiomatic: Prior-use purchasers were mostly eager and impatient climbers.

sentences.zh: 多一先用之人，即多一害民之人。

translations.literal: Each additional prior-use person was one more person who harmed the people.
translations.idiomatic: Each additional prior-use appointee was one more official who would harm the people.

sentences.zh: 不待辨而知其不可。

translations.literal: Without debate one knows this is impermissible.
translations.idiomatic: No debate was needed to see it was impermissible.

sentences.zh: 」乾隆年事例屢開，惟雙月、單月，不論雙月選用及雙月先用，不論雙、單月即用等尋常班次。

translations.literal: " In the Qianlong years regulations were opened repeatedly, but only for bi-monthly and monthly ordinary quotas—not bi-monthly selection, bi-monthly prior use, or bi- and monthly immediate use.
translations.idiomatic: " During the Qianlong era regulations reopened repeatedly, but only for ordinary bi-monthly and monthly quotas—not the special prior-use or immediate-use categories.

sentences.zh: 蓋是時正途銓補，未病雍滯，無庸加捐花樣，納資者亦至是而止。

translations.literal: For at that time regular-route selection was not yet congested; there was no need to add patterned contributions, and contributors stopped at that.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the regular route was not yet congested; patterned contributions were unnecessary, and contributors went no further.

sentences.zh: 七年，部議鼓勵江省賑捐，各班選用特優。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the ministry deliberated encouraging Jiangsu relief contributions with especially favorable selection across quotas.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 7, the ministry encouraged Jiangsu relief contributions with especially favorable selection priority.

sentences.zh: 道光年，增插班間選、抽班間選、遇缺、遇缺前等名目。

translations.literal: In the Daoguang years were added inserted inter-quota selection, drawn inter-quota selection, vacancy appointment, and pre-vacancy categories.
translations.idiomatic: In the Daoguang era came inserted inter-quota selection, drawn inter-quota selection, vacancy appointment, and pre-vacancy categories.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，省遇缺、遇缺前，而增分缺先、本班侭先。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng, vacancy and pre-vacancy categories were reduced, while split-vacancy priority and full-quota priority were added.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 1, vacancy categories were trimmed while split-vacancy priority and full-quota priority were added.

sentences.zh: 三年，復增分缺間、不積班。

translations.literal: In the third year, split-vacancy inter-quota and non-accumulating quota were added again.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 3, split-vacancy inter-quota and non-accumulating quota categories were added.

sentences.zh: 九年，先後奏設新班遇缺、新班侭先、分缺先前，分缺間前、本班侭先前、不論班侭遇缺選補等班。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, new-quota vacancy, new-quota priority, split-vacancy pre-priority, split-vacancy inter-pre, full-quota pre-priority, and regardless-of-quota vacancy selection quotas were established in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 9, a succession of new quotas was established: new-quota vacancy, new-quota priority, split-vacancy priorities, and regardless-of-quota vacancy selection.

sentences.zh: 推廣捐例，又有保舉捐入候補班、候補捐本班先用例。

translations.literal: Under extended regulations there were also recommendation contributions into awaiting-appointment quotas and awaiting-appointment contributions for prior use within one's quota.
translations.idiomatic: Extended regulations also added recommendation purchases into awaiting-appointment quotas and awaiting-appointment prior-use within one's quota.

sentences.zh: 花樣繁多，至斯已極。

translations.literal: Patterned contributions were numerous; by then they had reached their extreme.
translations.idiomatic: Patterned contributions had multiplied to their utmost extreme.

sentences.zh: 自籌餉例開，既多立班次以廣捐輸，復減折捐例以期踴躍。

translations.literal: Since fund-raising regulations opened, many quotas were established to broaden contributions, and contribution rates were discounted to encourage eagerness.
translations.idiomatic: Since fund-raising regulations opened, many quotas broadened contributions while discounted rates encouraged giving.

sentences.zh: 時納捐率以餉票，成數或不及定額之半。

translations.literal: Contributions were often paid in supply certificates; the actual amount sometimes did not reach half the fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Contributors often paid in supply certificates; actual amounts sometimes fell below half the fixed rate.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，另訂加成新章。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi, new bonus regulations were separately fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 3, new bonus regulations were issued.

sentences.zh: 於是有銀捐新班、侭先、遇缺等項，輸銀不過六成有奇，而選用之優，他途莫及。

translations.literal: Thereupon were silver-contribution new quota, priority, vacancy, and other items; silver paid was barely over sixty percent, yet selection priority was unmatched by other routes.
translations.idiomatic: Silver-contribution new quotas, priority, and vacancy categories required barely sixty percent payment yet enjoyed selection priority no other route could match.

sentences.zh: 八年，吏部以銀班遇缺佔缺太多，擬改分班輪用，刪不積班，於新班遇缺上，別設十成實銀一班，曰新班遇缺先，是謂大八成花樣。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Ministry of Personnel, because silver-quota vacancy holders occupied too many posts, proposed rotating by split quotas and deleting non-accumulating quota; above new-quota vacancy a separate full-silver quota was set called new-quota vacancy priority—this was the great eighty-percent patterned contribution.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 8, the Ministry of Personnel, finding silver-quota vacancy holders occupied too many posts, proposed rotation and created a full-payment quota called new-quota vacancy priority—the great eighty-percent patterned contribution.

sentences.zh: 維時分缺先前、分缺間前、本班侭先前、新班遇缺、新班遇缺先，統曰銀捐。

translations.literal: At that time split-vacancy pre-priority, split-vacancy inter-pre, full-quota pre-priority, new-quota vacancy, and new-quota vacancy priority were collectively called silver contribution.
translations.idiomatic: Split-vacancy priorities, full-quota pre-priority, new-quota vacancy, and new-quota vacancy priority were collectively termed silver contribution.

sentences.zh: 而新班遇缺先最稱優異，新班遇缺次之。

translations.literal: New-quota vacancy priority was most superior; new-quota vacancy came next.
translations.idiomatic: New-quota vacancy priority ranked highest; new-quota vacancy came next.

sentences.zh: 序補五缺一週，先用新班遇缺先三人，然後新班遇缺及各項輪補班各得其一。

translations.literal: In sequential appointment, five vacancies per cycle: first three new-quota vacancy priority holders, then new-quota vacancy and each rotating quota each received one.
translations.idiomatic: In each five-vacancy cycle, three new-quota vacancy priority holders were appointed first, then new-quota vacancy and each rotating quota received one each.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，江蘇巡撫吳元炳言：「新班遇缺先、新班遇缺等班，序補過速，有見缺指捐之弊。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu, Jiangsu Governor Wu Yuanbing said: "New-quota vacancy priority and new-quota vacancy quotas appoint too quickly, creating the abuse of targeting vacancies for contribution.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 2, Jiangsu Governor Wu Yuanbing said: "New-quota vacancy quotas appoint too quickly, encouraging contributors to target specific vacancies.

sentences.zh: 請停捐免試用例，以救其失。

translations.literal: He requested stopping purchase exemption from probation to remedy the fault.
translations.idiomatic: He requested halting purchase exemption from probation to remedy the abuse.

sentences.zh: 」格於部議。

translations.literal: " It was blocked by ministry deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministry blocked the proposal.

sentences.zh: 四年，實官及各項花樣一律停捐。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, substantive offices and all patterned contributions were uniformly halted.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 4, substantive offices and all patterned contributions were uniformly halted.

sentences.zh: 七年，御史葉廕昉復言：「近年大八成各項銀捐班次，無論選、補，得缺最易，統壓正途、勞績各班。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Censor Ye Yinfang again said: "In recent years the great eighty-percent silver-contribution quotas, whether for selection or supplementary appointment, obtain vacancies most easily and uniformly suppress the regular route and merit quotas.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 7, Censor Ye Yinfang again said: "Recent great eighty-percent silver-contribution quotas obtain vacancies most easily and uniformly suppress the regular route and merit quotas.

sentences.zh: 今捐例已停，請改訂章程，銀捐人員，祗列捐班之前。
