translations.literal: Now that contribution regulations have stopped, he requested revising the rules so silver contributors are listed only before the contribution quota.
translations.idiomatic: With purchase regulations halted, he requested revising rules so silver contributors rank only before the contribution quota.

sentences.zh: 」疏下部議。

translations.literal: " The memorial was sent to the ministry for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial went to the ministry.

sentences.zh: 然積重難返，進士即用知縣，非加捐花樣，則補缺綦難，他無論已。

translations.literal: Yet habits were hard to reverse: jinshi immediate-appointment district magistrates, without adding patterned contributions, found filling vacancies extremely difficult—to say nothing of others.
translations.idiomatic: Yet old habits died hard: jinshi immediate-appointment magistrates could scarcely obtain posts without patterned contributions, to say nothing of others.

sentences.zh: 十年，台灣海防相繼例開，三班分先、分間、侭先，復得一體報捐，而知縣並增海防新班。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Taiwan coastal defense regulations opened in succession; three quotas of split priority, split inter, and full priority could again report contributions uniformly, and district magistrates gained a coastal defense new quota.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 10, Taiwan coastal defense regulations reopened; split-priority, inter-quota, and full-priority quotas could contribute again, and magistrates gained a coastal defense new quota.

sentences.zh: 十三年，鄭工新例增遇缺先班捐例等，大八成班次亦相埒，海防新例因之。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Zhengzhou works new regulations added vacancy-priority quotas; great eighty-percent quotas were comparable, and coastal defense new regulations followed.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 13, Zhengzhou works regulations added vacancy-priority quotas; great eighty-percent quotas matched, and coastal defense regulations followed suit.

sentences.zh: 至二十七年，各項花樣隨實官捐並停。

translations.literal: By the twenty-seventh year, all patterned contributions were halted along with substantive-office contributions.
translations.idiomatic: By Guangxu 27, all patterned contributions halted along with substantive-office purchases.

sentences.zh: 初捐納官但歸部選，乾隆間，為疏通選途，許加捐分發。

translations.literal: Initially contributed officials were selected only by the ministry; during Qianlong, to clear the selection path, additional contribution for provincial dispatch was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Initially purchased officials were selected only by the ministry; during the Qianlong era, additional payment for provincial dispatch was permitted to ease congestion.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，豫工例，京職郎中以下，得捐分各部、院。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, under Henan works regulations, capital officials from directors downward could purchase dispatch to various departments and courts.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 26, under Henan works regulations, capital officials from directors down could purchase dispatch to various departments.

sentences.zh: 外官道、府以下，得捐分各省。

translations.literal: Provincial officials from circuit intendants downward could purchase dispatch to various provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial officials from circuit intendants down could purchase dispatch to various provinces.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，川運例，知州、同知、通判捐分發如舊。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year, under Sichuan transport regulations, department magistrates, sub-prefects, and sub-circuit magistrates could purchase dispatch as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 39, under Sichuan transport regulations, department magistrates, sub-prefects, and sub-circuit magistrates could purchase dispatch as before.

sentences.zh: 知縣有兒正途補用，靳不與。

translations.literal: District magistrates had the regular route for supplementary appointment and were stingily not granted dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: District magistrates were reserved for the regular route and were stingily denied dispatch.

sentences.zh: 四十年，兵部侍郎高朴言：「捐班知縣，不許分發，恐有兒舉班。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year, Vice Minister of War Gao Pu said: "Contributed-quota district magistrates are not permitted dispatch, fearing harm to the juren quota.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 40, Vice Minister of War Gao Pu said: "Contributed-quota magistrates are denied dispatch for fear of harming the juren quota.

sentences.zh: 查壬辰科會試後，揀選分發，已閱四年，湖北、福建均因差委乏人，奏請揀選，可見舉班漸已補完。

translations.literal: Investigation shows that after the renchen-year metropolitan examination, selection and dispatch have passed four years; Hubei and Fujian both, lacking men for assignments, memorialized for selection—showing the juren quota is gradually filled.
translations.idiomatic: Since the renchen-year metropolitan examination four years had passed; Hubei and Fujian both lacked assignees and requested selection—showing the juren quota was gradually filling.

sentences.zh: 請變通事例，川運捐不論雙單月即用者，許一體報捐分發。

translations.literal: He requested flexible application of regulations: Sichuan transport contributors regardless of bi- or monthly immediate use may uniformly report contribution for dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: He requested flexibility: Sichuan transport contributors of all immediate-use categories might uniformly purchase dispatch.

sentences.zh: 」部議如所奏行。

translations.literal: " The ministry deliberated and implemented as memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministry approved as proposed.

sentences.zh: 惟大省分發不得逾十二人，中省不得逾十人，小省不得逾八人。

translations.literal: Only large provinces could not exceed twelve dispatches, medium provinces ten, small provinces eight.
translations.idiomatic: Large provinces were capped at twelve dispatches, medium at ten, small at eight.

sentences.zh: 雲、貴兩省需員解送銅鉛，雲南得分發二十人，貴州如大省額。

translations.literal: Yunnan and Guizhou needed men to transport copper and lead; Yunnan could dispatch twenty, Guizhou the large-province quota.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan and Guizhou needed men to transport copper and lead; Yunnan received twenty dispatches, Guizhou the large-province quota.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was followed.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 是年兵部奏請候補、候選衛守備、衛千總如文職例，加捐分發，隨漕學習。

translations.literal: That year the Ministry of War memorialized that awaiting-appointment and candidate garrison commandants and company commanders, like civil officials, could purchase additional dispatch and study with the grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Ministry of War approved awaiting and candidate garrison commandants and company commanders purchasing dispatch and studying with grain transport, like civil officials.

sentences.zh: 明年，浙江巡撫三寶奏請教職捐不論雙單月即用者，設加捐分發，到省委用。

translations.literal: The next year, Zhejiang Governor Sanbao memorialized that educational officials contributing regardless of bi- or monthly immediate use could set additional dispatch and be employed provincially on arrival.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, Zhejiang Governor Sanbao requested educational officials of all immediate-use categories could purchase dispatch and be employed on arrival.

sentences.zh: 均報可。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 川運例停分發，歸入常例報捐，為永例。

translations.literal: Sichuan transport regulations halted dispatch; it was incorporated into standing contribution reporting as a permanent rule.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan transport dispatch was halted and incorporated into standing contributions as a permanent rule.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，以山東布政使陸燿言東省分發佐雜漸多，停布政司經歷、理問、州同以下佐雜官分發例。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year, because Shandong Provincial Administration Commissioner Lu Yao said dispatched deputies in the east were gradually numerous, dispatch of provincial administration experience, director of studies, department assistant, and lower deputies was halted.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 42, because Shandong Commissioner Lu Yao reported too many dispatched deputies, dispatch of registrars and lower deputies was halted.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，候補布政司經歷鄭肇芳等、候選州同張衍齡等具呈戶部，以投供日久，部選無期，各省佐雜班已疏通，請准報捐分發，為奏行如舊例。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year, awaiting-appointment provincial administration experience Zheng Zhaofang and others and candidate department assistant Zhang Yanling and others petitioned the Ministry of Revenue: having reported for duty long with no ministry selection in sight, provincial deputy quotas were already cleared—they requested permission to report contribution for dispatch, and memorialized implementation as in the old rule.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 46, awaiting registrars and candidate deputies petitioned the Ministry of Revenue: after long waits with no selection, provincial deputy quotas were clear—they requested purchase dispatch, and the old rule was restored.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，給事中廣興請將俊秀附生報捐道、府、州、縣者，停銓實缺，准加捐分發。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, Supervising Secretary Guang Xing requested that genteel supplemental students reporting contribution for circuit, prefectural, departmental, and county posts halt substantive selection and be permitted additional dispatch by contribution.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4, Supervising Secretary Guang Xing requested genteel supplemental students purchasing circuit through county posts halt substantive selection and purchase dispatch instead.

sentences.zh: 責成督、撫試看三年，酌量題補。

translations.literal: Governors were charged to observe them for three years and recommend appointment as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Governors were to observe them for three years before recommending appointment.

sentences.zh: 帝以停選示人不信，令加捐分發，有礙政體，不允行。

translations.literal: The emperor held that halting selection showed distrust of the people; permitting additional dispatch by contribution harmed proper governance and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that halting selection showed distrust; permitting purchase dispatch harmed governance and was rejected.

sentences.zh: 道、咸間，增加捐指省例。

translations.literal: Between Daoguang and Xianfeng, contribution for designated-province dispatch was increased.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Daoguang and Xianfeng eras, purchase for designated-province dispatch increased.

sentences.zh: 光緒四年，捐例停，而分髮指省以常例得報捐如故。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Guangxu, contribution regulations stopped, but dispatch to designated provinces could still be reported under standing regulations as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 4, purchase regulations halted, but designated-province dispatch continued under standing regulations.

sentences.zh: 五年，御史孔憲以指省分發，流弊不可勝言，請罷之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Censor Kong Xian, because designated-province dispatch had abuses beyond counting, requested abolishing it.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 5, Censor Kong Xian, citing countless abuses of designated-province dispatch, requested abolishing it.

sentences.zh: 格部議，不果行。

translations.literal: Blocked by ministry deliberation, it was not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry blocked it.

sentences.zh: 八年，復申前請，部覆如議。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the previous request was renewed; the ministry replied as deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 8, the request was renewed; the ministry approved.

sentences.zh: 未幾，海防例開，仍准報捐。

translations.literal: Before long, coastal defense regulations opened and reporting contributions was again permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Soon coastal defense regulations reopened and purchases were permitted again.

sentences.zh: 時分發人員擁擠殊甚，疆吏輒奏停分發，期滿復請展限，各直省比比然也。

translations.literal: At the time dispatched personnel were extremely crowded; frontier officials repeatedly memorialized to halt dispatch, and when terms expired requested extensions—every province was alike.
translations.idiomatic: Dispatched personnel crowded every province; governors repeatedly halted dispatch and requested extensions when terms expired.

sentences.zh: 定例，捐納官分發各部、院學習三年，外省試用一年。

translations.literal: By regulation, contributed officials dispatched to departments and courts studied three years; in the provinces they served probation one year.
translations.idiomatic: By regulation, purchased officials dispatched to capital departments studied three years; in provinces they served one year on probation.

sentences.zh: 期滿，各堂官、督、撫實行甄別奏留，乃得補官。

translations.literal: When terms expired, department heads and governors conducted real evaluation and memorialized retention before they could fill posts.
translations.idiomatic: On expiry, department heads and governors evaluated them and memorialized retention before appointment.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十六年，諭：「捐納員簽分部、院學習行走年滿，當詳加甄別。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Jiaqing, an edict said: "Contributed officials assigned to departments and courts who complete their study term should be carefully evaluated.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 16, an edict declared: "Purchased officials completing departmental study must be carefully evaluated.

sentences.zh: 近來該堂官於行走報滿人員，無不保留。

translations.literal: Recently these department heads retain all who report completion of service.
translations.idiomatic: Recently department heads retained every official reporting completion.

sentences.zh: 市恩邀譽，不顧登進之濫，可為寒心。

translations.literal: Currying favor and seeking reputation, disregarding the excess of advancement—this is chilling.
translations.idiomatic: Currying favor while disregarding indiscriminate advancement—this was chilling.

sentences.zh: 」道光八年，諭：「酌增常例報捐，分發人員為數更多，著各督、撫、鹽政留心察看，不必拘定年限，認真甄覈。

translations.literal: " In the eighth year of Daoguang, an edict said: "With adjusted standing contributions, dispatched personnel are more numerous; governors and salt commissioners should observe carefully, not bound by fixed terms, and evaluate earnestly.
translations.idiomatic: " In Daoguang 8, an edict declared: "With more dispatched personnel under adjusted standing contributions, governors and salt commissioners must observe carefully, not bound by fixed terms, and evaluate earnestly.

sentences.zh: 」然奉行日久，長官循例奏留，徒有甄別之名，不盡遵上指也。

translations.literal: " Yet practiced long, superiors routinely memorialized retention—evaluation existed in name only, not fully following the imperial intent.
translations.idiomatic: " Yet over time superiors routinely memorialized retention—evaluation existed in name only, not in practice.

sentences.zh: 咸豐七年，從御史何兆瀛請，詔各部、院考試捐納司員，察其能否辦理案牘。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xianfeng, following Censor He Zhaoying's request, an edict ordered departments and courts to examine contributed clerks on whether they could handle documents.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 7, following Censor He Zhaoying's request, departments and courts were ordered to test purchased clerks on document handling.

sentences.zh: 尋兵部試以論題，御史硃文江以為言，詔切責之。

translations.literal: Soon the Ministry of War tested with essay topics; Censor Zhu Wenjiang spoke of this, and an edict sharply rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Ministry of War tested with essays; Censor Zhu Wenjiang complained, and an edict sharply rebuked them.

sentences.zh: 命嗣後毋得以考試虛文，徒飾觀聽。

translations.literal: It was ordered that hereafter examinations must not be empty formalities merely for show.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth examinations were forbidden as empty formalities for show.

sentences.zh: 外官分發到省，例由督、撫考試，分別等第，黜陟有差。

translations.literal: Provincial officials dispatched to provinces were by regulation examined by governors, graded, and promoted or dismissed with differences.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial officials were examined by governors on arrival, graded, and promoted or dismissed accordingly.

sentences.zh: 光緒初，各省遵例考試，顧雲南有咨回降調者。

translations.literal: Early in Guangxu, provinces followed regulations in examination, but Yunnan had some returned with demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Guangxu era provinces followed examination regulations, though Yunnan returned some with demotion.

sentences.zh: 五年，詔各省考試捐納人員，府、廳、州、縣試論一，佐雜試告示判語。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an edict ordered provinces to examine contributed personnel: prefectural, departmental, and county officials took one essay; deputies took proclamation judgment.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 5, an edict ordered provincial examination of purchased officials: prefects and magistrates wrote one essay; deputies judged proclamations.

sentences.zh: 八年，閩浙總督何璟言：「閩省應試府、廳、州、縣百五十四員，鹽大使五十五員，佐雜五百九十六員，知府、直隸州知州、鹽大使取留十之五，同、通、佐雜留十之四。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Fujian-Zhejiang Governor He Jing said: "In Fujian, 154 prefectural and county examinees, 55 salt commissioners, and 596 deputies took examination; of prefects, Zhili department magistrates, and salt commissioners five-tenths were retained, of sub-prefects, sub-circuit magistrates, and deputies four-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 8, Fujian-Zhejiang Governor He Jing reported: "Fujian examined 154 prefectural and county officials, 55 salt commissioners, and 596 deputies; prefects and salt commissioners were retained at fifty percent, sub-prefects and deputies at forty percent.

sentences.zh: 」報聞。

translations.literal: " This was reported.
translations.idiomatic: " This was reported to the court.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，憲政編查館議覆御史趙炳麟疏，捐納道、府、同、通、州、縣佐雜未到省者，入吏部學治館肄業半年。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, the Constitutional Research Bureau replied to Censor Zhao Binglin's memorial: contributed circuit, prefectural, sub-prefect, sub-circuit, departmental, county, and deputy officials not yet arrived in province should study half a year at the Ministry of Personnel's Governance Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 33, the Constitutional Research Bureau replied to Censor Zhao Binglin: purchased officials not yet in province should study half a year at the Ministry of Personnel's Governance Academy.

sentences.zh: 已到省，入法政學堂肄業，長期三年，速成一年有半。

translations.literal: Those already in province entered law schools: long course three years, accelerated one and a half years.
translations.idiomatic: Those already in province entered law schools for three years or an accelerated eighteen months.

sentences.zh: 尋議上考驗外官章程，各省遵章考試，間亦罷黜數人，以應明詔，而于澄清吏治之道無補也。

translations.literal: Soon regulations for examining provincial officials were submitted; provinces followed in examination and occasionally dismissed a few to respond to the clear edict—but this did not aid the path of clarifying official governance.
translations.idiomatic: Soon examination regulations for provincial officials were adopted; provinces occasionally dismissed a few to satisfy the edict—but this did little to clarify official governance.

sentences.zh: 貢監捐清初已行。

translations.literal: Tribute and academy contributions were practiced from early Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute and academy purchases were practiced from early in the Qing.

sentences.zh: 監捐沿明納粟例。

translations.literal: Academy contribution followed the Ming grain-purchase precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Academy purchase followed the Ming grain-purchase precedent.

sentences.zh: 順治十二年，開廩生捐銀准貢例，從御史楊義請也。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Shunzhi, the regulation for granary students contributing silver for permitted tribute was opened, following Censor Yang Yi's request.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 12, granary students were permitted to purchase tribute status with silver, on Censor Yang Yi's request.

sentences.zh: 十七年，禮部以亢旱日久，請暫開准貢，令士民納銀賑濟。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, the Ministry of Rites, because drought had lasted long, requested temporarily opening permitted tribute so scholars and commoners could contribute silver for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 17, the Ministry of Rites, citing prolonged drought, requested temporarily opening permitted tribute for relief contributions.

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: This was granted.
translations.idiomatic: This was granted.

sentences.zh: 貢監例得考職，康熙六年，御史李棠言：「進士、舉人遲至十年始得一官，今例監考補中書，三年後即升部屬，應停罷。

translations.literal: Tribute and academy students were permitted examination for office; in the sixth year of Kangxi, Censor Li Tang said: "Jinshi and juren wait as long as ten years for one post; now purchased academy students examine for Secretariat drafter and after three years rise to ministry staff—this should be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute and academy students could take office examinations; in Kangxi 6, Censor Li Tang said: "Jinshi and juren wait ten years for a post, while purchased students become Secretariat drafters and ministry staff in three years—this should stop.

sentences.zh: 」部覆如議。

translations.literal: " The ministry replied as deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministry agreed.

sentences.zh: 自是貢監考職，祗以州同、州判、縣丞、主簿、吏目用。

translations.literal: From this, tribute and academy examination for office used only department assistant, department judge, county assistant, registrar, and clerk posts.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter tribute and academy examination for office was limited to department assistants, county assistants, registrars, and clerks.

sentences.zh: 初考職例行，各省監生或憚遠道跋涉，或因文理不通，多倩代頂冒者。

translations.literal: When the examination-for-office rule first operated, provincial academy students either feared distant travel or, being unlettered, often hired substitutes to impersonate them.
translations.idiomatic: When the rule first operated, students either feared distant travel or, being unlettered, hired substitutes.

sentences.zh: 世宗深知其弊，特遣大臣司考試。

translations.literal: Shizong knew the abuses well and specially dispatched grand ministers to supervise examination.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzheng Emperor knew the abuses well and dispatched grand ministers to supervise examinations.

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，令與考者千一百餘人悉引見，時以頂冒避匿者九百餘人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, over eleven hundred examinees were all presented; at the time over nine hundred had impersonated or evaded by hiding.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5, over eleven hundred examinees were presented; over nine hundred had used substitutes or evaded examination.

sentences.zh: 帝於引見員中揀選七十餘人，授內、外官有差。

translations.literal: The emperor selected over seventy from those presented and appointed them to capital and provincial posts with differences in rank.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor selected over seventy and appointed them to capital and provincial posts.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，停考職。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, examination for office was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1, examination for office was stopped.

sentences.zh: 三年，令捐納貢監如歲貢例，分別等第，以主簿、吏目考取。

translations.literal: In the third year, contributed tribute and academy students were ordered like annual tribute graduates to be graded and examined for registrar and clerk posts.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 3, purchased tribute and academy students were graded like annual tribute graduates and examined for registrar and clerk posts.

sentences.zh: 捐監未滿三年者不與。

translations.literal: Purchased academy students of less than three years were not included.
translations.idiomatic: Purchased academy students of less than three years were excluded.

sentences.zh: 道光後，考職例罷。

translations.literal: After Daoguang, the examination-for-office rule was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: After the Daoguang era, examination for office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 雍正間，帝以積貯宜裕，允廣東、江、浙、湖廣以本色納監。

translations.literal: During Yongzheng, the emperor, holding that stores should be ample, permitted Guangdong, Jiangsu-Zhejiang, and Huguang to contribute to the academy in kind.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng era, the emperor permitted Guangdong, Jiangsu-Zhejiang, and Huguang to pay academy fees in grain.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，罷一切捐例。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, all contribution regulations were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1, all purchase regulations were abolished.

sentences.zh: 廷議捐監為士子應試之階，請於戶部收捐，備各省賑濟，從之。

translations.literal: The court deliberated that academy contribution was a step for scholars to take examinations; it requested collection at the Ministry of Revenue for provincial relief, and this was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court held that academy purchase was a step toward examinations; collection at the Ministry of Revenue for provincial relief was approved.

sentences.zh: 三年，詔復行常平捐監例，各省得一體納本色。

translations.literal: In the third year, an edict restored the ever-normal granary academy-contribution regulations; all provinces could uniformly contribute in kind.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 3, an edict restored ever-normal granary academy purchases; all provinces could pay in grain.

sentences.zh: 原定各省捐穀三千餘萬石，數年僅得二百五十餘萬石，復令戶部兼收折色。

translations.literal: Originally each province was to contribute over thirty million shi of grain; in several years barely two and a half million shi were obtained—the Ministry of Revenue was again ordered to collect commuted payments as well.
translations.idiomatic: Provinces were to contribute over thirty million shi of grain; in several years barely 2.5 million were collected—the Ministry of Revenue was again ordered to accept silver payments.

sentences.zh: 十年，湖廣總督鄂彌達言：「捐監事例，穀不如銀。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Huguang Governor-General E Miada said: "For academy contribution regulations, grain is inferior to silver.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 10, Huguang Governor-General E Miada said: "For academy purchases, grain is inferior to silver.

sentences.zh: 銀有定數，穀無成價。

translations.literal: Silver has a fixed amount; grain has no fixed price.
translations.idiomatic: Silver has a fixed rate; grain has no fixed price.

sentences.zh: 易捐穀為捐銀，倘遇荒歉，亦可動支採買。

translations.literal: Changing grain contribution to silver contribution, if famine occurs funds can still be drawn to purchase grain.
translations.idiomatic: Switching from grain to silver, funds could still be drawn to buy grain in famine.

sentences.zh: 」允行。

translations.literal: " This was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: " This was approved.

sentences.zh: 大學士等復言：「各省納本色，有名無實，請停止，專由部收折色。

translations.literal: Grand secretaries again said: "Provincial payment in kind is nominal without reality—request stopping it and having the ministry alone collect commuted payments.
translations.idiomatic: Grand secretaries again said: "Provincial grain payments were nominal only—stop them and have the ministry collect silver alone.

sentences.zh: 」得旨：「各省收捐不必停，在部捐折色者聽。

translations.literal: " An edict said: "Provincial collection need not stop; those contributing commuted payments at the ministry may do so.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ruled: "Provincial collection need not stop; contributors paying silver at the ministry were permitted.

sentences.zh: 」三十一年，以陝、甘監捐積弊最甚，詔停罷。

translations.literal: " In the thirty-first year, because Shaanxi and Gansu academy contributions had the worst accumulated abuses, an edict halted them.
translations.idiomatic: " In Qianlong 31, because Shaanxi and Gansu academy purchases had the worst abuses, an edict halted them.

sentences.zh: 尋並罷安徽、直隸、山西、河南、湖南北，惟雲南、福建、廣東收本色如舊。

translations.literal: Soon Anhui, Zhili, Shanxi, Henan, and Hunan-Hubei were also halted; only Yunnan, Fujian, and Guangdong collected in kind as before.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Anhui, Zhili, Shanxi, Henan, and Hunan-Hubei were halted too; only Yunnan, Fujian, and Guangdong continued grain collection.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，陝西巡撫畢沅、陝總督勒爾謹請如例收納監糧，允之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year, Shaanxi Governor Bi Yuan and Shaan-Gan Governor-General Le Erjin requested collecting academy grain as per regulations; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 39, Shaanxi Governor Bi Yuan and Shaan-Gan Governor-General Le Erjin requested collecting academy grain as regulated; approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 是年甘省奏報六個月內捐監萬九千十七名，監糧八十餘萬石。

translations.literal: That year Gansu reported that within six months 19,017 academy contributors and over 800,000 shi of academy grain were collected.
translations.idiomatic: That year Gansu reported 19,017 academy purchasers and over 800,000 shi of grain collected in six months.

sentences.zh: 帝疑之。

translations.literal: The emperor was suspicious.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor grew suspicious.

sentences.zh: 布政使王亶望主其事，私收折色，減成包辦，更虛報賑災，侵冒鉅款。

translations.literal: Provincial Administration Commissioner Wang Tanwang directed the affair, privately collecting commuted payments, reducing rates and monopolizing contracts, further falsely reporting disaster relief, and embezzling vast sums.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial Commissioner Wang Tanwang directed it, privately collecting silver at reduced rates, monopolizing contracts, falsely reporting disaster relief, and embezzling vast sums.

sentences.zh: 繼任布政使王廷贊知其弊，不能革。

translations.literal: His successor Wang Tingzan knew the abuses but could not reform them.
translations.idiomatic: His successor Wang Tingzan knew the abuses but could not stop them.

sentences.zh: 事覺，置亶望、勒爾謹、廷贊於法，官吏緣是罷黜者數十人，報捐監生或加捐職官者，分別停科、罰俸、停選。

translations.literal: When the matter was exposed, Wang Tanwang, Le Erjin, and Wang Tingzan were punished by law; dozens of officials were dismissed thereby; academy students or those who added contribution for official rank were respectively barred from examinations, fined salary, or halted in selection.
translations.idiomatic: When exposed, Wang Tanwang, Le Erjin, and Wang Tingzan were executed; dozens of officials were dismissed; contributors were barred from examinations, fined, or halted in selection.

sentences.zh: 其後監捐無復納粟遺意矣。

translations.literal: After this, academy contribution no longer retained the original intent of contributing grain.
translations.idiomatic: After this, academy purchase no longer retained the original intent of grain contribution.

sentences.zh: 貢捐屬常例，向於部庫報捐。

translations.literal: Tribute contribution belonged to standing regulations and was reported at the ministry treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute purchase fell under standing regulations and was reported at the ministry treasury.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶間，疆吏屢以為請，輒阻部議。

translations.literal: During Jiaqing, frontier officials repeatedly requested this but were always blocked by ministry deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiaqing era, provincial officials repeatedly requested this but the ministry always blocked it.

sentences.zh: 十二年，部臣言庫帑充裕，請變通常例，各省一體收捐。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, ministry officials said the treasury was ample and requested changing standing regulations so all provinces could uniformly collect contributions.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 12, ministry officials cited a full treasury and requested all provinces uniformly collect tribute purchases.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was granted.

sentences.zh: 此外尚有捐馬百匹予紀錄、運丁三年多交米三百石給頂帶之例。

translations.literal: Besides this there were regulations for contributing one hundred horses for merit records, and for transport workers over three years delivering an extra three hundred shi of rice for rank insignia.
translations.idiomatic: There were also regulations for contributing one hundred horses for merit records, and for transport workers delivering extra rice for rank insignia.

sentences.zh: 其樂善好施例內，凡捐資修葺文廟、城垣、書院、義學、考棚、義倉、橋樑、道路，或捐輸穀米銀兩，分別議敘、頂帶、職銜、加級、紀錄有差。

translations.literal: Within the charitable-contribution regulations, all who contributed funds to repair Confucian temples, city walls, academies, charity schools, examination sheds, charity granaries, bridges, and roads, or contributed grain, rice, or silver, received differentiated merit review, rank insignia, nominal rank, grade increase, or merit records.
translations.idiomatic: Under charitable-contribution regulations, those funding repairs to temples, walls, academies, schools, examination halls, granaries, bridges, and roads, or contributing grain or silver, received graded rewards of merit review, insignia, nominal rank, grade increases, or merit records.

sentences.zh: 餘如各省鹽商、士紳，捐輸鉅款，酌予獎敘。

translations.literal: Others such as provincial salt merchants and gentry who contributed large sums received discretionary awards.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial salt merchants and gentry who contributed large sums also received discretionary awards.

sentences.zh: 皆出自急公好義，與捐納相似，而實不同也。

translations.literal: All sprang from public-minded righteousness; they resemble purchase of office but are in fact different.
translations.idiomatic: All sprang from public-spirited generosity; they resemble purchase of office but were in fact different.
